evidence.summary: Default export: a non-empty string parses as a duration in milliseconds; a finite number formats short, or long when the options object sets long. Unrecognized strings produce no value.

features.name: Parse a duration string
features.behavior: Units s, m, h, d, w, y and their long names, with an optional space, fraction or leading minus. A year is 365.25 days. Unrecognized strings have no JSON value (a harness writes JavaScript undefined as null).

features.name: Short format
features.behavior: Largest unit among ms, s, m, h and d, rounded the way JavaScript Math.round rounds.

features.name: Long format
features.behavior: Same units as words. The unit is plural when the absolute value is at least 1.5 of that unit.
